digest.component_or_area: Jira reconciler rich-text sync (Cloud ADF + Data Center wiki)
propositions: Cloud must encode Markdown descriptions and comments as structured ADF paragraphs instead of plain text, with 99%+ idempotent round-trip fidelity over the corpus.

Data Center must render safe Markdown descriptions and comments as native Jira wiki markup via pandoc segmentation, with timeout/subprocess hardening and graceful fallback on missing pandoc or pathological input.

Echo-safety layer using per-binding baselines, change-gated rich_sha, and three-way LWW comparison must suppress unchanged second passes and flag all concurrent edits while preserving Jira-native constructs (panels, mentions, dates) via origin-gating.
Comment creation must use append-only comment-ID maps routed through the same rich-text codec as descriptions, ensuring DC and Cloud comments encode identically to their description counterparts.

Production cutover must be single-pass: descriptions cut over first, then both descriptions and comments cut over together with echo-safety enabled, verified by live Docker Jira DC harness with rendered HTML expansion.
